trials.rationale: The agent only averaged 3 of the 5 Orlando hotels (missing Universal Studios and Enchanted Suites), yielding 4.63 vs the true 4.62, and failed to note the tool evidence was incomplete for a corpus-wide claim.

judge_samples.rationale: The agent only averaged 3 of the 5 Orlando hotels (missing Universal Studios and Enchanted Suites), yielding 4.63 vs the true 4.62, and failed to note the tool evidence was incomplete for a corpus-wide claim.
The agent only averaged the 3 hotels it retrieved (4.63) rather than all 5 Orlando hotels (true mean 4.62), missing two properties and not flagging that its search may be incomplete.

The agent computed an average (4.63) using only 3 of the 5 Orlando hotels, omitting Universal Studios (4.5) and Enchanted Suites (4.7), and implied this was the full set, though the numeric result happens to be close to the true 4.62 mean; the values used are correctly taken from the retrieved evidence, so the claims are grounded but the coverage is materially incomplete.
